title: Taskelith review checklist record
description: An OpenSpec change's checklist.json: the review checklist of its brief, written by npm run findings -- checklist ... --save <change> --at <dev commit> before the first review pass, from the archive as of the brief's dev commit. npm run findings -- effect compares the change's pass-1 findings with it. Unknown properties are rejected.

generatedAt.description: UTC time of the generation, as JavaScript's Date.prototype.toISOString writes it.

devCommit.description: Full SHA of the dev commit given with --at, the one that the brief's checklist names, whose archived findings the checklist ranks.

query.description: The arguments of the brief's checklist invocation.

size.description: Task size as the brief gives it; npm run findings -- effect weighs S 1, S-M 1.5, M 2, M-L 2.5, and L 3 size points.

review.description: The review checklist section, whose baseline counts every archived finding outside openspec/changes/, whatever the query.

recordQuality.description: The record quality section, whose baseline counts every archived finding under openspec/changes/.

categories.description: The ranked categories, most frequent first, with their counts.

baseline.description: The archived findings of the section's population, all and Medium or worse, and how many of them have a listed category.
